detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Many abandoned houses are full of ghosts. These can be the souls of suicides or demons. It could be the spirit of a vampire, slowly sucking the blood from everyone who comes near



ADVANTAGES

  • 20 types of unique ghosts - the souls of people and strange creatures, as well as several types of demons
  • Each ghost has its own unique attack and animations
  • Over 60 types of detailed tools for collecting evidence and fighting ghosts
  • You can determine the type of ghost, its age and mood
  • 7 game locations filled not only with clues to catch ghosts, but also with interesting Easter eggs
  • Different types of game modifiers, they help diversify the gameplay



GAMEPLAY

You will have to explore the ghost, and then catch it! In this hunt everything is important: look for evidence, find out the age of the ghost, feel what kind of mood it is in

EARLY ACCESS

We will be adding new ghosts and new locations to the game
